purpose: Fill Mining / Fishing / Farming / Woodcutting planner gaps for Equilibrium elective-region routing. Region IDs use repo Equilibrium electives (forinthry = wiki Wilderness). No invented XP/h — locations and unlock dependencies only, sourced from RS Wiki rock/tree pages, Ironman guides, and members training pages. Wiki League Region columns are preferred when present; Fort Forinthry taxonomy remains the working Catalyst→Misthalin mapping unless noted.
